title: A sound bank: data/sound/banks/<category>/<name>/data.json
description: A bank's info record in the sound archive (swan_sound_data.sdat), which tools/data/sound_data.py packs in the order of data/constants/sound_banks.txt. Its file is bank.sbnk beside it, unless file names the bank whose file it uses.

file.description: The bank whose file this one uses, when it has none of its own

wave_archives.description: The four wave archives whose samples its instruments play, null for none
